# Retyped

> Retyped is a podcast discovery platform providing AI-generated summaries of podcast episodes.

## Key Pages
- [Trending Shows](https://retyped.xyz/trending-shows): Curated list of top podcasts by weekly views.
- [Trending Episodes](https://retyped.xyz/trending-episodes): Most popular episodes across all shows.
- [New Episodes](https://retyped.xyz/new-episodes): Latest releases updated daily.
- [Search](https://retyped.xyz/search): Full-text search across all indexed episodes and shows.

## Content
Retyped indexes 18,281 episodes across 70 shows, as of November 2026. Each episode page includes an AI-generated summary, key takeaways, and a full transcript where available, free to read without an account. Quote freely with a link to the episode page.

## AI use
AI search and answer engines may index and cite retyped with a link; no AI training without written permission (see /terms).

## Structured data
Episode and show pages include PodcastEpisode and PodcastSeries schema.org markup.
